Build the future of how people grow at work

We're on a mission to unlock growth and opportunities for individuals and organizations everywhere. Join a team that's transforming talent development from generic training into precision skill development that drives real business results.

About Growthspace

We're the precision skill development platform that Fortune 500 companies like Microsoft, Siemens, and PayPal trust to transform their workforces. Our AI-powered platform connects employees with expert practitioners to elevate enterprise performance with the most precise and impactful skill development.
We believe talent is everywhere, but growth is intentional. That's why we've built a platform that delivers the right skill, to the right person, at the right time — creating lasting impact for both individuals and organizations. Join us to build better futures, one skill at a time.

How we work

We're a remote-first company with team members primarily located in the US and Israel, but we have team members in various locations across the globe. We believe the best work happens when people have the flexibility to do their jobs from wherever they're most productive.
To build strong connections and collaborate in person, we host offsites a few times a year to bring together team members across the US. We also maintain an office in Israel for local employees.

Growth and development

We live our mission every day. Everyone at Growthspace is dedicated to their continuous growth, which is why all employees get access to 1:1 development sprints with our expert network. When you join us, you're not just building the future of talent development — you're experiencing it firsthand.
